title: Names Beginning With A
description:
Report the `name` of every employee whose name begins with the letter `A`.

Name the column `name`. Return the result in any order.
schemaSql:
CREATE TABLE departments (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  location TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE employees (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  title TEXT,
  salary INTEGER,
  dept_id INTEGER,
  manager_id INTEGER,
  hire_date TEXT
);
solutionSql: SELECT name FROM employees WHERE name LIKE 'A%';
hint: LIKE with a trailing wildcard. In SQLite, LIKE is case-insensitive for ASCII by default.
outputExplanation: Only Ava has a name beginning with the letter A.
